rounds.text: The valuation of Nath Industries Ltd at a price-to-book of 0.37x [E2] is a classic value trap masking severe structural underperformance. Capital efficiency is persistently abysmal, highlighted by a 10-year median return on equity of just 4% [E26] that has degraded further to 3% over 5 years [E27], 2% over 3 years [E28], and 3% over the last year [E29]. This is compounded by a weak ROCE of 5.4% [E12] that underperforms the sector median of 6.3% [E72]. Profit growth is moving sharply in the wrong direction, collapsing by 28% over the trailing twelve months [E21] and contracting by 14% over a 5-year span [E19]. Furthermore, the business delivers poor sales growth of 11.6% over the past five years [E63] and returns nothing to shareholders with a dividend yield of 0.00% [E4]. Conceded: [E18].
